newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel to launch financing prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel to launch financing prospectus.

text.p: Channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA/Plc said it will launch the prospectus for its financial restructuring at a news conference in Paris on Thursday at 0830 local time (0630 GMT).

The company needs shareholder approval for the deal, which seeks to restructure nearly nine billion stg of debt owed to a 225-strong bank syndicate. Agreement with a group of lead banks was reached in April.
Eurotunnel has linked the success of the restructuring with its request for an extension of its concession to operate the tunnel which expires in 2052.

Earlier this month, the French government said it had asked Britain to consider an unspecified extension but Britain's Transport Department said on Tuesday it was not aware of any formal request to consider an extension.
Eurotunnel co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle asked for an extension of as much as 999 years which would put a different complexion on the company's debt profile.
